tools.name: get_td_node_errors
tools.description: Check errors and warnings on a node and its descendants. TouchDesigner reports missing files, dangling operator references and shader compile failures as warnings, so do not treat hasErrors=false as a healthy node. Reads the operator errors and warnings streams only: an exception raised inside a Script OP callback, a scriptCHOP onCook for example, lands on neither and is reported nowhere here, so an empty report is not evidence the node cooked

nodePath.description: Absolute path to the node to inspect. e.g., "/project1/text1"
